node_definition.done_when: Done when. A test stores a review whose findings are plain text, one marked blocking and one non-blocking, delivers a newer head for the run, and reads a re-review brief composed listing both findings with their severities. A second test disposes the non-blocking plain-text finding and reads the disposition recorded. A negative control that reads a plain-text finding as a record raises the same AttributeError in the first test. The gate runs on all_debug and its log is written to the section's evidence fragment.
node_definition.goal: A review whose findings are plain text does not stop its run being reviewed again
